theory.md: О будущем после **when, as soon as, until, before, after, unless** — настоящее время. **unless** = if not: We'll go **unless** it rains (если не пойдёт дождь). **as soon as** — как только, **until** — пока не, до тех пор, пока.

cells: I won't go unless you come with me.
I'll call you as soon as I arrive.
Wait here until I come back.
Drink some water before you go.

theory.md: После **unless** отрицание не ставят: unless you **come** (если ты не придёшь), а не «unless you don't come».

examples.es: We'll start as soon as everyone is here.
examples.ru: Мы начнём, как только все соберутся.

examples.es: Don't open it until I say so.

examples.es: You can't pass unless you answer.

options: As soon as I arrive, I'll call.
